# chinairantrucks

> 中国到伊朗 TIR 公路卡航干线庄家。国内集货仓（义乌 / 深圳平湖 / 广州白云 / 上海）→ 德黑兰西关（Gomrok Gharb）/ 阿普林陆港 / 沙赫里亚尔海关。经霍尔果斯口岸出境、萨拉赫斯口岸入境，14–18 天直达海关保税库。仓到关（CPT / DAP），不做门到门。运价单询。
> First-hand China–Iran cross-border TIR road-freight carrier. Consolidation hubs in China (Yiwu, Shenzhen/Pinghu, Guangzhou, Shanghai) → Tehran West Customs (Gomrok Gharb), Aprin Dry Port, or Shahriyar Customs. Exit China at Khorgos, enter Iran at Sarakhs; 14–18 days to the bonded customs warehouse. Hub-to-customs (CPT / DAP), not door-to-door. Freight quoted on request. Contact exim@isacogroup.com or WhatsApp +86 132 3740 1856 (wa.me/8613237401856).

## 核心事实 / Key facts

- 模式 / Model: 仓到关 / 站到关，不做门到门、不做 DDP；CPT / DAP 德黑兰海关交货，由收货人清关行清关缴税提货 / hub-to-customs, not door-to-door / DDP; CPT / DAP Tehran Customs, consignee's broker clears
- 集货仓 / Origin hubs: 义乌苏溪、深圳平湖、广州白云、上海；也可交到霍尔果斯监管区 / Yiwu (Suxi), Shenzhen (Pinghu), Guangzhou (Baiyun), Shanghai
- 路线 / Route: 霍尔果斯 — 哈萨克斯坦(阿拉木图–奇姆肯特) — 土库曼斯坦(法拉普–马雷) — 萨拉赫斯 — 德黑兰西关 / Khorgos — Kazakhstan — Turkmenistan — Sarakhs — Tehran West Customs
- 口岸 / Gateways: 出境 霍尔果斯(主) / 伊尔克什坦(次)；入境 萨拉赫斯(主) / 因切布伦(次) / exit Khorgos (primary) / Irkeshtam; enter Sarakhs (primary) / Incheboron
- 时效 / Transit: 14–18 个自然日,国内集货仓至德黑兰西关保税库;马什哈德海关单询 / 14–18 calendar days, hub to Tehran West Customs bonded warehouse
- 目的海关 / Destination customs: 德黑兰西关 Gomrok Gharb / گمرک غرب تهران、沙赫里亚尔 Shahriyar、阿普林陆港 Aprin Dry Port、马什哈德 Mashhad
- 交割凭证 / Handover: 海关入库单 Ghabz-e Anbar / قبض انبار;伊朗海关系统 ASYCUDA / warehouse entry receipt; Iran customs system ASYCUDA
- 货类 / Cargo: 普货(汽配/电子/机械/建材) + 9类锂电 UN3480/3481、光伏与储能 BESS、超限大件机械、化工原料(附 MSDS);整车/新能源车/成套项目另询 / general cargo + Class 9 lithium (UN3480/3481), solar & BESS, out-of-gauge machinery, chemicals with MSDS; complete vehicles quoted separately
- 装法与起运 / Modes: 整车 FTL(13.6m 帘布车 / 17.5m 低平板) 与拼箱 LCL,1 CBM 或 100 KG 起;每周二、周五发车 / FTL and LCL from 1 CBM or 100 kg; weekly Tuesday & Friday departures
- 车队与保障 / Fleet: 45+ 台斯堪尼亚/沃尔沃 480–540HP + Krone/Schmitz 帘布挂车;北斗三号+GPS 双模定位、门磁电子封签;CMR 一切险每车最高 25 万美元;TIR 国际道路运输经营资质,霍尔果斯与德黑兰派驻调度 / 45+ Scania/Volvo tractors, Beidou-3+GPS, electronic seals, CMR insurance up to USD 250,000 per load, registered TIR operator
- 0.4%: 仅伊尔克什坦(过吉尔吉斯)次要路径有,是货值发票 0.4% 税、不是运费;霍尔果斯–哈萨克斯坦走廊不加 / only on the Irkeshtam (Kyrgyzstan) secondary routing, a 0.4% invoice-value tax, not freight
- 询价三样 / To get a quote: 始发仓 origin hub;目的海关 destination customs;货物数据(HS 编码、总重 KG、体积 CBM) cargo data
- 不做 / Not offered: 网页挂运价 no published rates;伊朗清关 Iran customs clearance;海运/铁运报价(中吉乌铁路在建未通) sea/rail quotes (CKU railway not open)
- 联系 / Contact: exim@isacogroup.com · WhatsApp https://wa.me/8613237401856 · Telegram https://t.me/Aliboby88
